summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/operations/export/[manifestId] GET route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before export manifest authorization succeeds.

redGreenEvidence.observed: Both new unsafe export manifest identity tests failed with HTTP 200 because validly signed but unsafe actorId/sessionId values reached manifest readback and course ownership authorization instead of being rejected at the authenticated-session boundary.

redGreenEvidence.command: ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed export manifest|requires signed teacher course ownership before serving export manifests"

behaviorHardened: Signed export manifest cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed export manifest cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before export manifest download authorization can succeed and before course ownership checks run.
The denial response preserves trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.
